features.name: Email Registration with OTP Verification
features.userProblem: Account security — verify email ownership before activation
features.businessValue: Prevents fake accounts, ensures communication channel validity

features.name: Multi-Provider Social Login (Google, Facebook, Apple)
features.userProblem: Reduce registration friction for users with existing social accounts
features.businessValue: Higher conversion rate, Apple Sign-In required for iOS App Store

features.name: Geospatial Ride Search with Direction Awareness
features.userProblem: Find rides matching both location proximity AND travel direction
features.businessValue: Higher match quality, fewer false positives in search results

features.name: Ride Creation with Automatic Chat Room
features.userProblem: Offer empty seats and enable coordination with future passengers
features.businessValue: Supply-side enablement — any user can offer rides

features.name: Atomic Seat Booking with Overbooking Prevention
features.userProblem: Prevent two users from booking the same seat simultaneously
features.businessValue: Data integrity, user trust in booking confirmations

features.name: Democratic Vote-Kick System
features.userProblem: Remove disruptive passengers without centralized moderation
features.businessValue: Peer-governed safety, no need for 24/7 moderation team

features.name: Real-Time Group Chat (per ride)
features.userProblem: Coordinate pickup details without exchanging personal contact info

features.name: Post-Ride Mutual Rating System
features.userProblem: Build trust by establishing reputation through ride history

features.name: Automated Ride Lifecycle Management
features.userProblem: Stale rides and chat rooms pollute search results and consume storage
features.businessValue: Clean data, relevant search results, controlled storage growth

features.name: 25-Language Localization
features.userProblem: Non-English speakers need the app in their language

features.name: In-App Notifications with Auto-Expiry
features.userProblem: Stay informed about ride events (joins, kicks, completions, ratings)

engineeringChallenges.title: Geospatial Ride Matching with Direction Awareness
engineeringChallenges.summary: Two-phase matching: MongoDB $geoNear for proximity + in-memory bearing calculation for direction

engineeringChallenges.title: Concurrent Seat Booking with Overbooking Prevention
engineeringChallenges.summary: Mongoose pre-save hook with aggregation-based seat count validation

engineeringChallenges.title: Weighted Democratic Vote-Kick System
engineeringChallenges.summary: Vote weight proportional to seats held, threshold = ceil(50% of active seats), cascade cleanup

engineeringChallenges.title: Automated Ride Lifecycle Management
engineeringChallenges.summary: Two cron jobs: auto-complete rides (10min), cleanup expired chats (2min)

engineeringChallenges.title: Multi-Provider Authentication with Token Rotation
engineeringChallenges.summary: Four auth providers (email+OTP, Google, Facebook, Apple) converging to unified JWT token pair

engineeringChallenges.title: Transactional Post-Ride Rating with Bulk Submission
engineeringChallenges.summary: MongoDB session transaction for bulk rating insertion with self-rating prevention

assumptions_requiring_confirmation: Developer's specific role (solo developer, lead developer, team contributor, etc.)
Whether the app is published on App Store and/or Play Store
Active user count and usage metrics
The purpose and origin of obfuscated code in ecosystem.config.js
Whether the MongoDB Atlas cluster is a paid production tier
limitations: No payment integration (Stripe field exists in user schema but is unused)
No push notifications (only in-app via Socket.IO)
No automated test files present (Jest/Supertest configured but unused)
Single-process deployment (no Redis adapter for Socket.IO scaling)
No map visualization in the mobile app
CORS set to allow all origins
User blocking field exists in schema but is not enforced in ride search/join
